primary_goal: Learn real design DECISIONS from excellent finished lettering and maker-published work-in-progress, demonstrate transferable artistic gain on unseen Chinese words; do not confuse static diagrams, geometric operations or successful Figma exports with success.

visible_actual_stages: hand-drawn/traced exploratory outline marked hand-painted first draft
direct_creator_evidence.direct_visual_observation: Across two same-character rows, the middle outline drafts clearly are not a flat stroke-width expansion; the finals merge and prioritize distinct structural masses and shaped terminals.
direct_creator_evidence.limitation: Historical reference is NOT first designer-authored intermediate; finished-font artwork cannot reveal physical pen speed/pressure or unique artist algorithm.

visible_actual_stages: overlay explicitly labels correction of 阝 radical
direct_creator_evidence.direct_visual_observation: There is a before/after outline shift in the same component's proportions and curve trajectory, beyond a full-image filter or global stroke taper.
direct_creator_evidence.limitation: DO NOT confuse this 阝 demonstration with the different prose example where a widened 口 design had to be rolled back after a large-character set test.

before_after_trace_statistics.caveat: This is source raster pixel-color separation, NOT an aesthetic score, writer curve points, degree of artist-like transfer, or hand trajectory.

visible_actual_stages: top BEFORE and lower AFTER Chinese phrase
bottom BEFORE/AFTER magnified narrowed terminal/counter with labels
direct_creator_evidence.direct_visual_observation: The same compressed-style glyph uses a locally different inner aperture/corner shape after correction; improving smaller counters calls for localized geometry, not whole-glyph uniform narrowing.
direct_creator_evidence.limitation: This figure does not on its own establish effects on unknown calligraphic lettering or a controlled typography preference win.

visible_actual_stages: normal-width face characters 仁 and 空
condensed C80 variant with differently arranged internal negative space
direct_creator_evidence.direct_visual_observation: Condensed design changes relative internal spaces and structural balance; visually distinct from a literal squeezed screenshot.
direct_creator_evidence.limitation: The labels describe standard vs C80 FONT VARIANTS, not author-before vs author-after chronological stages. EXCLUDE from before/after training pairs.

source_faithful_hypotheses.source_support: Historical letter reference, outline draft and final bold stylized form visibly differ through whole-glyph drawing stages.
source_faithful_hypotheses.candidate_decision: Before decorating/inking target: compare whole silhouette and glyph skeleton with source language; design dominant gesture and negative space on a separate whole-glyph draft; only afterwards produce final artistic surfaces.
source_faithful_hypotheses.rejected_shortcut: Do not copy historical contour then merely increase uniform width or attach random flywhite splatter.
source_faithful_hypotheses.falsification: If new unfamiliar glyph becomes illegible or remains mechanically close to a base font after purported decision stage, candidate fails.
source_faithful_hypotheses.limitation: Specific details of final deformation are not attributable to precise historical strokes or sequence; no author vector masters.

source_faithful_hypotheses.source_support: Before (red) and after (blue) for 阝 radical in same glyph and across font review, with substantive observable contour displacement. Project lead also describes changes to separate 口 radicals only after thousands of glyphs revealed that the initial wider style did not generalize.
source_faithful_hypotheses.candidate_decision: Before announcing a reusable radical component, check its presence in multiple character structures and positions; adjust the entire component locally and re-review side-bearing/neighboring counter shapes; reject a globally unchanged shape if it causes a consistency problem.
source_faithful_hypotheses.rejected_shortcut: Do not reuse identical SVG path or fixed x-axis stretch for all appearances of the radical.
source_faithful_hypotheses.falsification: If a supposed shared radical behaves identically in left/right, sparse/dense contexts or destroys recognizable inner counters, candidate fails.
source_faithful_hypotheses.limitation: 阝 figure and the 口 rollback are two distinct author examples, never conflate their underlying before/after pixels.

source_faithful_hypotheses.source_support: Before and after same Chinese condensed text, with inset magnifying a specific opening/corner correction.
source_faithful_hypotheses.candidate_decision: For condensed/high-pressure layout, identify individually collapsing enclosed negative spaces and redraft nearby geometry to protect legibility, considering other characters in phrase.
source_faithful_hypotheses.rejected_shortcut: Do not claim a uniform horizontal squash is the documented artist revision.
source_faithful_hypotheses.falsification: If fine-scale counters close or local repair disrupts stroke relations/word rhythm, candidate fails.
source_faithful_hypotheses.limitation: This source is an office/corporate modern display font, not proof of brush-splash calligraphy quality.

forbidden_promotion: Do not treat ARPHIC_FANGXINSHU_SPACE as chronological before-vs-after; it compares standard and C80 width variants.
Do not claim independent human aesthetics were rated; no such test was performed.
Do not claim image source rights include model training or commercial reuse of original glyph outlines.
Do not reuse old R2 width-profile transfer, R5 tip-width transfer, R8 compensation metric, R9 x-affine-width scheme as a purported new full-method result.
Do not claim authors' actual finger/brush path trajectories can be inferred from display images.
This source-gate success does not show style/distilled aesthetic success.
constrained_next: Use only one visual authoring hypothesis and author-confirmed source stages, not all three styles blended. Freeze visually testable structural actions on unseen Chinese characters, run single equal-budget baseline-vs-hypothesis output and let human compare. Any unauthorized source imagery copying or paywall triggers STOP, not tool purchase.
